# Docsautomator

Automate your documents using Google Docs in minutes. Create, manage, and generate documents from templates with the DocsAutomator API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docsautomator/.

## Actions

- **Create Automation**: Create a new DocsAutomator automation with specified data source and optional Google Doc template.
- **Delete Automation**: Permanently delete an automation and all associated data.
- **Get Automation Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific automation by its ID.
- **List Automations** (read-only): Retrieve all automations in your workspace with their basic details.
- **Update Automation**: Update an existing automation's settings in DocsAutomator.
- **Duplicate Automation**: Create a copy of an existing automation with ' COPY' appended to the title.
- **Get Queue Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve current document generation queue statistics for your workspace.
- **List Signing Sessions** (read-only): Retrieve signing sessions with optional filtering by status or signer email.
- **Send Test Email**: Send a test email with a sample PDF attachment to verify email configuration.
